method: Control battery run against the bundle's OWN 47 file_check verifiers, read live from tests/manifest.json and executed by the bundle's own rl_world_verifiers engine (tests/rl_world_verifiers.run_verifier, the same call tests/verifier_engine.py makes), against CSV pairs derived from the real oracle replay (gold) and from the naive readings in requirements.json (mutants).

positive_control.description: the oracle's own CSVs, written verbatim from solution/artifact_plan.json

semantic_mutation.description: judge the two conditional yeses against the UTC date of the note that settles them (Diego's 6 May review, Cameron's roadmap review flip to OWES_ANSWER; tracker fixes recomputed to match)

granularity_mutation.description: collapse the source column: every answered row written as INVITATION (the 9 EMAIL rows lose their source)

cosmetic_mutation.description: reversed row order, every field double-quoted, CRLF line endings, OWES_ANSWER written in lower case

incompleteness_mutation.description: bound the window in UTC: Customer Escalation Sync (Sun 17 May 17:30 Pacific) and its 3 rows dropped

adversarial_acceptance_mutation.description: spray every ledger key with all five status/source pairs and every tracker entry with all three statuses, hoping the per-row regexes each find their row

empty_workspace.description: no files written (what an agent that stops before writing gets)

summary.strictness: positive_control: 47/47; semantic_mutation: 44/47; granularity_mutation: 38/47; cosmetic_mutation: 47/47; incompleteness_mutation: 43/47; adversarial_acceptance_mutation: 45/47; empty_workspace: 0/47
summary.brittleness: cosmetic mutation scores 47/47: row order, quoting, line endings and label case do not matter (row regexes are case-insensitive, quote-tolerant and line-anchored)
summary.note_on_write_back_checks: the 17 database_state checks (7 sole-recipient drafts naming the owed meetings, 7 reply-thread checks, recipient count, draft count, nothing sent), the 2 rubric_check verifiers and the tool_execution floor need a live gym or judge; they were exercised end to end by the real oracle run (reward 1.0, 67/67) and by the GLM battery (two runs 67/67; two runs that wrote nothing pass only nothing_was_sent and the trace-read rubric)

rubric_validation_summary.method: pending: written by consistency_llm.py with real calls to the judge endpoint
